name: io.github.cayocan/mefcs-mcp
description: Control M-VAVE Tank-G pedals and install TONE3000 tones through the M-EFCS USB bridge

environmentVariables.name: MEFCS_BRIDGE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Full path to mefcs_ks_bridge.exe inside the M-EFCS install folder (auto-detected in standard locations)

environmentVariables.name: TONE3000_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: TONE3000 publishable key (optional, can also be saved at runtime)

environmentVariables.name: TONE3000_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for downloaded captures and IRs
